review_scope: Independent static review plus tiny CPU comparator selftests; no environment, update or GPU execution in this audit.
old_verification_gaps: Pristine versus edited default check used 128 synthetic pairs and one optimizer step.
The production 200,000-pair check exercised NC4 only, not the native default update over 20 minibatches.
There was no sampling-chain differential check with fixed noise or report of maximum absolute and relative differences.

new_static_coverage.actual_saved_batch: The pristine run is interrupted before its first update. The helper saves 20,000 observations, chains of shape (20000, 11, 4, 6), GAE advantages, returns, values and unclamped old log probabilities.
new_static_coverage.initial_conditions: Both versions restore the saved model, actor and critic optimizers, module training flags, and Python, NumPy, torch CPU and all visible CUDA generator states. Input equality is checked.
new_static_coverage.full_update: Each native update body is extracted from its source AST without numerical changes. The helper requires 20 actor and 20 critic steps, and five complete permutations of the 200,000 pairs.
new_static_coverage.per_minibatch: All nine loss and metric values plus named actor and critic gradients are collected immediately before each actor step. Every gradient must be present. Permutations are compared exactly.
new_static_coverage.after_update: Actor and critic parameters, the entire model, both optimizers and global RNG states are compared. Saved batch inputs must remain unchanged.
new_static_coverage.sampling: The two versions receive the same 21 noise tensors. Their returned 11-state chain, final action and all 20 transition states are compared. The sampling trace selects the minimum matching source line.
new_static_coverage.diagnostic_rng: Actual post-update diagnostics are bracketed by Python, NumPy, torch CPU and all visible CUDA default generator snapshots.
new_static_coverage.numerical_criteria: CPU requires literal byte equality. GPU permits absolute difference <= 1e-7 + 1e-5 * abs(reference). Maximum absolute and reference-relative differences are reported, and nonfinite tensor values fail.
new_static_coverage.source_bounds: The helper requires a clean scientific commit ab46b150fa34b5a5b457cd4062cd4c5ad830d964, only the two approved source differences from cc7234a, and unchanged numerical settings.

notes: The captured first-update AdamW states are empty; this is valid and explicitly reported.
CPU and GPU are independently differential-tested; this is not a CPU-versus-GPU comparison.
This independent review verifies helper coverage and its comparison logic. The full gate has not yet run.
